prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign) and home (new_flow) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome (+7.8% vs -6.3%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful, with both tests agreeing on positive noise-corrected results and one test winning (+8.1%).
Predictions were usually too high across most tests, but was too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Adoption Certificate Layout: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen with a side-by-side two-column layout showing the pet certificate on one side and adoption confirmation options on the other. (why: Adoption step conversion drops to 60.9% with a long median time of 89s. Organizing certificate details in a side-by-side layout makes reviewing and confirming adoption clearer.)
1: [home, new_screen] Generation Progress Preview Screen: Introduce a dedicated new screen before the waiting screen displaying live progress status for desktop pet asset rendering. (why: Home waiting takes 201s median and 2336s mean, causing drop-offs due to uncertainty about generation progress.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Scroll Onboarding Intro Flow: Transform the initial story screen into an interactive story-scroll presentation highlighting companion features before path selection. (why: Choose path takes 8s median / 514s mean with 23.8% dropoff, indicating users need engaging upfront context on pet interactions.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Step Relocation After Adoption Certificate: Shift the sign-in screen to occur immediately after adoption certificate completion rather than before pet selection. (why: Previous sign-in reorder tests showed strong positive agreement (+8.1%), leveraging pet creation investment to improve sign-in completion.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Data Loss Prevention Hint: Add an explicit safety hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links pet ownership and prevents data resets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing back in, making explicit persistence messaging vital.)
5: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Clarity and Troubleshooting Copy: Update the photo upload headline, body, and hint text with clear lighting and single-subject guidelines for custom pets. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing bad results, contributing to the 60.9% adoption bottleneck.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Notification Toggle: Enable a system notification toggle and hint on the home_intro screen so users get alerted when their pet appears on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet visibility issues and finish step mean time is 5815s. Desktop alerts bring users back when ready.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Engine Launch Wait Status: Display an estimated wait time indicator and tip carousel on the waiting screen while background rendering completes. (why: Home wait time is 201s median / 2336s mean; providing active feedback and desktop tips reduces drop-off while waiting.)
8: [finish, layout] Compact Home Welcome Dashboard: Switch the final home_intro screen to a clean compact layout focusing on launch readiness. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 23.9% and finish step mean time is long (5815s); a compact view helps users finish faster.)

Addresses long home wait time, but new screen/flow changes historically performed poorly (-8.5%).
